prompt: A young adult woman sits on a beige-grey woven sofa indoors, captured in a vertical 9:16 close social-media portrait. The camera is slightly above eye level, looking gently downward from the front. The subject is centered slightly high in the frame, showing her head, upper body, red skirt, and upper thighs. She faces the camera directly, her head slightly lowered, eyes looking straight into the lens with a calm, cool, distant expression. Preserve the soft oval face, slim straight nose, natural brows, refined eyes, and saturated red lips. Avoid an overly polished influencer face.  She has natural long black hair, center-parted or slightly off-center, with one heavy section falling over the shoulder and chest. The hair should look smooth but realistic, with natural strand separation and slight messiness. Makeup combines Chinese vintage elegance with East Asian social-media portrait styling: fair sheer base makeup, precise eyeliner, natural lashes, subtle blush, and rich red lipstick.  The outfit is an ornate red Chinese high-collar embroidered dress, inspired by a xiuhéfu or modern Chinese ceremonial dress. The top has a mandarin collar, gold piping, traditional frog buttons, pearl tassels, blue-white-gold floral embroidery, cloud motifs, and wide sleeve cuffs. The red satin fabric should have soft reflections and real folds, with tiny highlights on the gold thread, embroidery, and pearl details. The lower part is a red Chinese-style short skirt or ceremonial skirt panel, paired with purple lace thigh-high stockings. The lace band has floral patterns and a slightly sheer mesh texture.  Visible skin includes the face, a small part of the neck, hands, partial forearms, and the upper thigh area above the stockings. The skin tone is fair and lightly warm, with creamy softness and faint pink transitions under indoor light. Keep fine realistic skin texture; the skin should feel soft, clean, and gently wrapped by warm room light, with natural shadows, slight color variation, and real body contours. All visible skin must be clean and unmarked: no tattoos on the thighs or anywhere on the body, no red butterfly tattoo, no stickers, no body markings.  The background is an indoor sofa area with a beige-grey fabric sofa, warm grey large tile wall, and a small pale tabletop or side cabinet on the right. Lighting is soft warm indoor light or diffused window light, coming from the front-left or upper-left, brightening the face, red embroidery, hands, and upper legs. The image should feel soft, clear, low-contrast, and like a real social-media portrait, preserving sofa texture, tile lines, clothing wrinkles, natural fingers, and slight off-center framing. Avoid perfect studio lighting.  Negative prompt: tattoo, body tattoo, thigh tattoo, butterfly tattoo, sticker on skin, underage, school uniform, explicit nudity, oversexualized pose, plastic skin, over-retouched face, exaggerated body proportions, bad hands, extra fingers, over-sharpened HDR, low quality.
